newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Sharp SA maintained as buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Sharp SA maintained as buy.

text.p: -- Fonte Cindam investment bank said it is maintaining its buy recommendation on Brazilian electronics firm Sharp SA.
-- Bank analyst Andre Paes told Reuters that Sharp was showing improved results in the second half as a result of a restructuring.
-- "They have managed to achieve lower costs and reduced expenses," he said, adding the firm also has successfully renegotiated a joint-venture with Lucent Technologies Inc.
-- Fonte Cindam projects Sharp will post a $4 million profit for this year, $25 million for next year and $37 million for 1998. The company posted a 1995 net loss of $27 million.
-- Sharp voting common was unchanged at 2.50 reais while its preferred was up one centavo to 1.21 reais at 1244 local/1044 EDT on the Sao Paulo bourse.
